cases.message: `@allowedRoles(...)` is deprecated and stops loading in 0.26; write `@requiresAgentRole(...) or @requiresRank(...)` instead
cases.note: In its deprecation window (memql#5438): it loads and gates exactly as before, and every use warns naming the two annotations it splits into and the rewrite. `memqlmigrate --rewrite=allowed-roles` writes @requiresAgentRole("assistant", "specialist") here.
The same form with a list of person roles: the rewrite writes @requiresRank("writer"), the list's lowest rung.

cases.message: @allowedRoles on a tool takes one or more strings
